Useful property: Routes and layout conventions; documented static client export.
Material tradeoff: More framework surface than a minimal SPA. SSR gives little benefit to private local health review.
Decision: Default with SSR disabled.

Useful property: Small client build and direct component control.
Material tradeoff: Team must choose routing and project conventions. Not inherently slower or less capable.
Decision: Valid fallback based on actual team proficiency.

Useful property: Portable installation and cached shell.
Material tradeoff: Storage persistence may be denied or cleared; browser/device constraints complicate recovery.
Decision: Do not make it the sole authoritative record in this design.

Useful property: Can own device integrations and local storage.
Material tradeoff: Additional packaging, updates, permissions and platform testing.
Decision: Revisit if disconnected tablet use or native BLE is required.

Useful property: API schema and validation plus access to Python data tooling.
Material tradeoff: Two languages across the product; strict typing is not semantic medical validation.
Decision: Default.

Useful property: One language across client and server; JSON-schema validation.
Material tradeoff: Scientific parser equivalence must be demonstrated. Schemas must remain trusted application code.
Decision: Fallback when team evidence favors TypeScript end to end.

Useful property: Embedded local transactional engine; simple deployment.
Material tradeoff: One writer at a time; filesystem and linked-version qualification required.
Decision: Default for one backend owner.

Useful property: Server database and row-security policies.
Material tradeoff: Extra process, credentials, backups and migration work; policy owners/superusers can bypass RLS.
Decision: Choose if concurrency or defense-in-depth needs justify it.

Useful property: Strong analytical queries.
Material tradeoff: Analytical concurrency and conflict behavior do not remove workflow/authorization needs.
Decision: Use for analysis, not the initial transaction owner.

Useful property: Column/filter pushdown over selected batch files.
Material tradeoff: Compaction, manifests and versioned derivations still need ownership.
Decision: Add for high-rate/batch analysis; preserve originals.

Useful property: Current DuckDB docs describe additional multi-process approaches.
Material tradeoff: Extra catalog/protocol deployment; maturity claims require version-specific qualification.
Decision: Outside the first episode. Do not repeat the obsolete claim that DuckDB has no multi-process options.

Useful property: Exact identifiers and low deployment cost.
Material tradeoff: Synonyms and concept recall may be weaker than semantic retrieval.
Decision: Baseline; evaluate missed queries.

Useful property: May improve semantic recall.
Material tradeoff: Adds model/index versions, access filtering and another source of retrieval errors.
Decision: Add only after measured retrieval improvement.

Useful property: Multiple hardware backends and schema-shaped output.
Material tradeoff: Model conversion, templates and schema dialect compatibility must be qualified.
Decision: First candidate; bounded text tasks.

Useful property: Local API with model-management convenience.
Material tradeoff: Local and cloud modes both exist; local endpoint configuration alone does not prove no remote calls.
Decision: Alternative; lock downloaded local model and test no-egress cold start.

Useful property: Apple-silicon text generation and tuning tooling.
Material tradeoff: Hardware-specific choice. No claim that it runs on the team device has been measured.
Decision: Alternative if actual Apple hardware wins the task evaluation.

Useful property: Serving option for supported accelerators and workloads.
Material tradeoff: Current platform/backend installation requirements must match the host; unnecessary service complexity for one small episode.
Decision: Revisit for measured concurrent inference demand.

Useful property: Publisher-hosted open-weight candidate under Apache-2.0.
Material tradeoff: Not a validated medical model for this product; quantized artifact must be separately traced.
Decision: Evaluate against template baseline.

Useful property: Medical text/image research focus.
Material tradeoff: HAI-DEF terms, access agreement and explicit limits on direct clinical use; not optimized/evaluated for multi-turn applications per card.
Decision: Optional research comparator.

Useful property: Restart/retry ownership can remain inside one service.
Material tradeoff: Must implement leases, bounded retries, cancellation and idempotence deliberately.
Decision: Default; in-process callbacks alone are insufficient.

Useful property: May help many workers, schedules and operational visibility.
Material tradeoff: Another server and failure mode before the basic workflow is proven.
Decision: Defer until a measured requirement exists.

Useful property: Declarative components rendered from a trusted catalog.
Material tradeoff: Protocol adoption does not validate medical content, permissions or stable control placement.
Decision: Use the catalog idea; protocol optional.
